dct_description_sm: This study is an in-campaign poll of the 2022 Ontario General Election. The poll was conducted between May 29-31, 2022. A sample of 2501 eligible voters in Ontario aged 18+ was interviewed online (1501 through the Ipsos I-Say panel and non-panel sources) and by live-operator telephone interview (1000 through landline and cellphones). Online respondents earned a nominal incentive for their participation. Weighting was employed to ensure the sample’s composition reflected the adult population according to 2016 Census data. Respondents provided information on likelihood of voting, government and party preferences, and party leadership.
